title: Warratta Neck
summary: Warratta is a neck of land at Center Moriches between Barnes mill-pond on Terrell River and Senex Creek.
history_content: The neck belongs to the Moriches and Center Moriches waterway landscape, near other named places such as Paquatuck and Senex. Deed references appear in the historic moments below.
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Warratta, Waraeta, and Waracto. The interpretation appears tied to Warishone, a Native personal name analyzed as the loser or the forgetter; that reading remains uncertain.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names are social constructs that show people’s attachment to the land they live in; they help communities to navigate and orientate, pass down oral traditions, and demonstrate the changes to the landscape.”

— Francesco Perono Cacciafoco and Francesco Cavallaro, Place Names and Society (2023), chapter summary
preservation_content: Warratta preserves a Center Moriches neck name connected with Native landholders, neighboring creeks, and later colonial deed records.
whereintheworld_content: Blue/general approximate marker on the Center Moriches neck between Terrell River and Senex Creek. This is not an exact deed-boundary coordinate.
